InstallPage.title: Install MatchFinder
InstallPage.intro: Installing the app gets you a home screen icon and — on iPhone, the only way to get them at all — notifications for new requests, messages and matches.
iosSteps: Open this site in Safari (not Chrome or another browser).
Tap the Share icon (a square with an arrow pointing up) in the toolbar.
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
Open MatchFinder from the new icon on your home screen — push notifications only work from there, not from Safari itself.
androidSteps: Tap the menu (three dots, top-right) and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
InstallPage.androidBanner: Chrome may also show an install banner on its own — if so, that works too.
